evals.name: fresh-repo-writes-agents-md-only
evals.prompt: Set up agent instructions for this repo so coding agents know how to build, test, and work in it. Go ahead and write them.
evals.expected_output: Fixture pnpm-fresh (evals/build-fixtures.sh). Branch agents-only: a lean AGENTS.md at the root with pnpm-pinned commands including a single-test form, Never and Ask-first constraints, a Done-when with the CI commands, and the token-efficiency block once. No CLAUDE.md is created.
expectations: AGENTS.md exists at the repo root after the run
No CLAUDE.md or .claude/CLAUDE.md was created
AGENTS.md pins pnpm (not npm) and includes a single-test command for one file
AGENTS.md has a constraints section with both a Never tier and an Ask-first tier, and says src/generated/ is not hand-edited
AGENTS.md has a Done-when section naming the exact lint, typecheck, and test commands
AGENTS.md contains no directory tree and no overview that restates package.json or the README
'## Token Efficiency' appears exactly once in AGENTS.md
AGENTS.md has no '## Unit Tests' section, because the prompt did not ask for unit-test rules
AGENTS.md is under 200 lines
The run performed the shadow check (looked for CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md at or above the repo) before writing
The response includes a Step Completion Report ending in a Result line

The response ends with a final report whose first line is Result: COMPLETE, PARTIAL, or BLOCKED, followed by Evidence (checks that ran, with observed results), Uncertainty (at least the unobserved client load), and Decision (the pending user action, or No approval needed)

evals.name: explicit-claude-md-is-honored
evals.prompt: Create a CLAUDE.md for this project. Write it directly.
evals.expected_output: Fixture go-bare (evals/build-fixtures.sh). Branch claude-only: the user named CLAUDE.md and no AGENTS.md exists, so a standalone CLAUDE.md is written with the Go commands and the token-efficiency block. No AGENTS.md is created.
expectations: CLAUDE.md exists at the repo root
No AGENTS.md was created
CLAUDE.md includes go test ./... (or make test) and a single-test form such as go test ./internal/store -run TestKey
'## Token Efficiency' appears exactly once in CLAUDE.md
CLAUDE.md is under 200 lines and has no directory tree
The response states the target decision: CLAUDE.md because the user asked for it by name

evals.name: audit-flags-shadowed-agents-md
evals.expected_output: Fixture audit-shadowed (evals/build-fixtures.sh). Read-only audit: flags that CLAUDE.md shadows AGENTS.md (no @AGENTS.md import, only prose), the duplicated pnpm rule, the inferable layout line, and the missing token block; routes each failing line; modifies nothing.
expectations: No files were modified (git status is clean after the run)
The report says CLAUDE.md does not import AGENTS.md, so Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md only and ignores AGENTS.md
The report recommends replacing the 'Read AGENTS.md' prose with an @AGENTS.md import
The report flags the rule duplicated in both files (pnpm, not npm)
The report flags the source-layout line as inferable content
The report gives pass, fail, or N/A per checklist section
The report suggests /memory, /context, or /doctor prompt-audit to confirm what loads

The response ends with a final report whose first line is Result: COMPLETE, PARTIAL, or BLOCKED, keeps the audit verdict on the files separate from that run status, lists only checks that ran under Evidence, and names under Decision which fixes the user must approve
